question: What was the official theme for the National Technology Day, 2025?

options.text: YANTRA – Yugantar for Advancing New Technology, Research & Acceleration
PANTRA – Prapancha for Advancing New Technology, Research & Acceleration
TANTRA – Tapasya for Advancing New Technology, Research & Acceleration
MANTRA – Manovikas for Advancing New Technology, Research & Acceleration

solution:
The correct answer is __**YANTRA – Yugantar for Advancing New Technology, Research & Acceleration**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The official theme for **National Technology Day 2025** is **YANTRA – Yugantar for Advancing New Technology, Research & Acceleration**.
 
• This theme emphasizes the transformative power of technology in ushering in a new era (**Yugantar**) for India’s scientific and industrial landscape. ***Hence, statement 1 is correct.***
 
• The **National Technology Day** is celebrated every year on **May 11** across India to honor the contributions of scientists, researchers, and engineers.
 
• The **2025** theme focuses on accelerating the deployment of **Deep Tech**, **Artificial Intelligence**, and **Quantum Computing** to achieve the vision of **Viksit Bharat @2047**.
